name: board-vision
description: Dev tools only. The page itself needs no install: it loads its libraries from a CDN (import map in index.html).

scripts.css:check: pnpm run --silent css && git diff --exit-code --stat style.css
scripts.syntax: find . -name '*.js' -not -path './node_modules/*' -exec sh -c 'for f; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done' sh {} +
scripts.test: pnpm run unit && pnpm run syntax && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run css:check && pnpm run audit
